# SSOT: the cheap, fully deterministic "Build & test" gates — same input,
# same PR state, same result every time; no matrix flake, no external
# service, no timing dependence. One context (job `name:`, or job id when
# unset) per line, exactly as it appears in `ci/check-manifest.yml` and as
# `gh api .../jobs` reports it.
#
# Consumed by:
#   - `.github/workflows/ci.yml`'s `cancel-on-cheap-red` job, via its
#     `needs:` list (checked against this file by `ci/verify-manifest.py`,
#     run in `manifest-guard.yml` — the two representations can never drift).
#   - `.github/workflows/rerun-failed-once.yml`, which skips the automatic
#     retry when every failed job on a run is in this set: a deterministic
#     gate fails the same way on a rerun, so retrying it only burns runners.
#
# Adding a job here makes its failure both a cancel trigger and a no-rerun
# verdict — include only a job that cannot flake and cannot pass on a second,
# identical attempt.
artifact-guard
capabilities-docs-drift
cli-docs-drift
cli-transcripts-drift
clippy
diagnostic-tone
doc-string example gate
env-docs-drift
explain-page example gate (ADR 0059)
fmt
manifest-lock-consistency
markdown-parity
quick-check
requirements-docs-drift
stdlib-docs-drift
